measurement: Three interleaved A/B pairs per workload; process user+system CPU is primary, perf_counter wall secondary; setup/imports/wheel installation excluded; same trace enabled in both wheels.
contention: Known concurrent external fits and Lithium work, including work outside shared lock. Host load differs across runs, affecting wall and potentially CPU cost through cache/frequency interference. Observed CPU ratios are bounded observations, not isolated universal rates; no wall-time speedup claimed.
numerical_comparison: All six runs per workload match the immutable reference rows exactly. See paired-fit-summary.json and paired-equilibrium-summary.json.

timing_commands.fit: performance.py paired fit <pair 1..3> <28181e72 wheel> <659b2606 wheel>, one lock acquisition per pair, timeout 300 s
timing_commands.equilibrium: performance.py paired equilibrium <pair 1..3> <28181e72 wheel> <659b2606 wheel>, three short pairs in one timeout 120 s lock step

retention: Per-pair outputs concatenated in order into one timing/profile/summary file per workload; original numerical tables reused by hash.
